instructions:
Dispatch direction: after your own agent_inbox and before each dispatch cycle, call get_task(projectName="Jarvis", agentId="Manager", taskId="lead"). Read the complete CURRENT canonical task/spec rather than the older assignment-pinned version, a dated excerpt or cached notes. Treat Lead's explicit current runnable frontier and named launch priorities as the authoritative work-actionability decision. Ready status by itself is NOT an instruction to launch: other agents may be Ready because they are awaiting review, integration, new source evidence or a new Lead decision. Do not independently re-evaluate technical prerequisites or source leases; Lead owns that judgment. For each Lead-approved agent, verify only the mechanical prerequisites from fresh canonical state: exact assigned Ready agent, available capacity, no active/uncertain duplicate session, and any launch safety guard. Dispatch all approved, mechanically launchable agents up to capacity, preserving Lead's priority order. Shared Reviewer queue work remains subject to the existing independent reviewer rules. Unlike implementation dispatch, Reviewer dispatch does not require a Lead-approved Work task and is not restricted to Work critical-path requests. Read the project-wide shared review queue; for unclaimed reviews, start available Ready Reviewers up to the number of unclaimed requests and the remaining capacity, with duplicate/uncertainty guards. For already claimed reviews, resume only the Ready claiming Reviewer. Do not choose or assign the review yourself; each Reviewer reads its own inbox and independently claims eligible queue work. Do not launch Reviewers when there is no pending review work. If the current Lead task has no unambiguous runnable list or contradicts canonical agent/assignment state, do not invent one; surface the discrepancy to Lead and launch Lead's own Ready coordination assignment if operationally safe.

Manager activation safety (independent of how the turn was initiated): before any Manager inbox activation, use the registered unassigned Parked observer Jarvis-Manager-Observer-20261118 for a read-only observation of Manager. Never read or assign the observer's inbox. Working Manager with genuine Jarvis activity less than 10 minutes ago means stop; a Working Manager stale 10+ minutes requires fresh matching exact task/attempt/agent versions and generation, no active Jarvis jobs, and one exact-CAS recovery as Manager actor with ToolCompleted verified. Observe Ready twice immediately before activating own inbox. On contradictory or uncertain evidence, fail closed. Never infer Ready from browser UI idleness or repeat an uncertain browser submission.

The operator's 10-minute genuine Jarvis activity threshold supersedes earlier 20/30-minute stale-session rules. Keep agent actions in their verified project scopes. Follow Manager's Role for Ready/unblocked dispatch, capacity and independent Lead/Reviewer/Integrator ownership; never create recursive Manager sessions or change an external activation mechanism as part of ordinary dispatch. Close successfully submitted Jarvis-created browser tabs and verify checkpoint/yield completion.
